title: Choose the Works page structure
question: The world stays Parasya Pedia (ember, saffron, parchment, midnight, Outfit). Pick how the films are laid out. Each sketch is the first viewport.

options.label: Title index
options.lineage: end-credit rolls and festival title cards
options.thesis: The work as a numbered list of huge titles; the film you point at plays beside it.
options.viewport: "Works." heading, then a ruled index of huge titles with client and type; a sticky screen at right plays the hovered or first film.
options.risk: With one or two pieces the index reads thin until more films land.

raised.raise: Every piece carries a short number address (01, 02) so it can be named and linked.
One strict label grid (title / client / type) rules every row, nothing else in the row.

options.label: Contact sheet strip
options.lineage: 35mm contact sheets and edit-suite film strips
options.thesis: The films run as frames on one strip; the chosen frame projects large above it.
options.viewport: Midnight room: a large projector screen playing the selected film with its credits, a sprocketed strip of every other film below.
options.risk: On a phone the strip becomes a horizontal swipe, which hides how many films exist.

options.label: Hoarding wall
options.lineage: Kerala cinema hoardings and pasted film bills
options.thesis: Each film is a bill pasted on an ember wall, sized by its real aspect.
options.viewport: An ember wall of pasted bills, 9:16 reels as tall bills and 16:9 films as wide ones, each looping muted with its title set across the foot.
options.risk: The bill framing can compete with the films; the collage must stay ordered.

options.label: Plate section
options.thesis: Every film printed as a plate, registered at the corners and credited on a hairline row.
options.viewport: A parchment sheet: one large plate with corner crosshairs, a credit row under it, and an ember stamp reading Directed in Thrissur half off its corner.
options.case: The credit row maps exactly to title / type / client; loses narrowly on audience identification, since brand owners don't read annuals.
options.risk: Can feel like a design-industry in-joke rather than a studio reel.

options.label: Teletext service
options.case: Retro novelty; replaces the brand's palette.
options.kept: Every piece gets a number address.

options.label: Sneaker box stacks
options.thesis: Films as boxes pulled from a stack.
options.case: Hides the films behind lids; brand owners came to watch.
options.kept: One strict label grid rules every item.

options.label: Tensegrity column
options.thesis: Works held in a force diagram.
options.case: No relation between films and forces.

options.label: Ink basin
options.case: Heavy GPU effect competing with video playback.
options.kept: The surface itself should answer the pointer: hover plays the film.

options.label: Du Bois data portraits
options.case: No real numbers to chart; would invent claims.
options.kept: Commit colour fields at full strength.
